WITH status_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    s.healtheval,
    SUM(sc.scancount) as total_scancount,
    AVG(CAST(sc.gbsize AS REAL) / CAST(sc.spanmin AS REAL)) as avg_gb_per_min
  FROM scans sc 
  JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry 
  WHERE sc.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' 
    AND sc.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
    AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL 
    AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL 
    AND sc.spanmin > 0
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
mean_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) as overall_mean FROM status_stats
)
SELECT 
  ss.healtheval,
  ss.total_scancount,
  ss.avg_gb_per_min,
  ss.avg_gb_per_min - mc.overall_mean as gap_from_mean
FROM status_stats ss, mean_calc mc
ORDER BY ss.healtheval
